meta.name: supabase
meta.description: Use when doing ANY task involving Supabase. Triggers: Supabase products (Database, Auth, Edge Functions, Realtime, Storage, Vectors, Cron, Queues); client libraries and SSR integrations (supabase-js, @supabase/ssr) in Next.js, React, SvelteKit, Astro, Remix; auth issues (login, logout, sessions, JWT, cookies, getSession, getUser, getClaims, RLS); Supabase CLI or MCP server; schema changes, migrations, declarative schemas, security audits, Postgres extensions (pg_graphql, pg_cron, pg_vector).

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 管理应用后端的数据、登录鉴权与实时能力
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果正在开发全栈应用，需要统筹数据、登录与云端函数。
copy.tagline_en: Manage your app's backend data, authentication, and realtime features.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you're building full-stack apps and need to handle data, auth, and server logic.

howto.what: 在处理涉及 Supabase 的任务时,Claude 会先核对官方更新日志和文档确认最新用法,按安全清单检查配置,并用命令行或 MCP 执行操作并验证结果,产出经过核实的代码、SQL 或迁移文件。
howto.when: 当你提到 Supabase 旗下的产品(数据库、认证、Edge Functions 等)、客户端库、登录注册或 RLS 权限问题,或要求改表结构、跑 CLI 命令时触发。

say.text: 帮我检查这个 Supabase 项目的 RLS 策略,有没有权限漏洞。
say.note: Claude 会对照安全清单逐项排查。

say.text: 把这个表结构的变更生成一个迁移文件并跑验证。
say.note: 走生成迁移 + 验证的标准流程。

howto.what_en: When handling Supabase-related tasks, Claude first checks the changelog and docs to confirm current usage, reviews config against a security checklist, then performs and verifies operations via CLI or MCP, producing verified code, SQL, or migrations.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you mention Supabase products (Database, Auth, Edge Functions, etc.), client libraries, auth/RLS issues, or ask for schema changes or CLI/MCP operations.

say_en.text: Check the RLS policies in this Supabase project for permission vulnerabilities.
say_en.note: Claude will review against the security checklist item by item.

say_en.text: Use MCP search_docs to find Supabase's official logout flow.
say_en.note: Looks up docs first instead of guessing.

say_en.text: Turn this table change into a migration file and run verification.
